usage: Used as a noun to talk about the colour dark green. 例如：呢件衫係深綠色。
You can use it before a noun to describe things with a dark green colour. 例如：深綠色背包幾好睇。
It is common in everyday speech when describing clothes, objects, or nature. 例如：我鍾意深綠色嘅牆。
It can also be used when choosing or comparing colours. 例如：你想要深綠色定淺綠色？
